name: Patina
author: Erin Carter
description: An aged bronze plate in time-lapse: thresholded FBM carves mottled verdigris stains over darker metal, each stain rimmed by a thin line of raw bright bronze where oxide meets polish. Nothing orbits and nothing roams — the patch interiors stay matte and dark while all the light lives at the slowly creeping coastline between corrosion and metal, advancing edges glittering with fresh oxide and retreating ones baring warm bronze glints.

params.label: Creep speed
params.effect: Multiplies the rate of coastline drift; 0 freezes the mottling as a still engraved plate, 2 runs the corrosion as visible time-lapse.

params.label: Stain size
params.effect: Characteristic size of the verdigris stains in CSS pixels — fine speckled corrosion at the minimum, broad continental stains at the maximum.

params.label: Fringe brightness
params.effect: Brightness of the advancing crystal fringe and the bared-bronze glints behind retreating edges; 0 creeps matte and dark, 1.5 lights every moving shoreline.
